name: Waybill app
date: Platform for analysis, recognition, editing, storage, and consultation of waybill documents.
bigDescription: Waybill App is a full-featured system to upload, OCR, validate and store waybill documents, with search and history features. I worked on the frontend using React and Tailwind and integrated backend APIs for storage and Drive integrations.

name: Personal Portifolio
date: My personal portifolio, where i showcase my projects and skills
bigDescription: This is my personal portfolio site where I present projects, experience and technical skills. Built with responsive design in mind and lightweight interactions to keep navigation fast.

name: Route management app
date: Platform for creating new routes and comparing them with current routes, aimed at improving transportation processes.
bigDescription: Route management app helps planners create and compare routes to optimize delivery times and costs. I contributed to the interface and mapping integration using Maps APIs and visualization components.

name: Vel.IO
date: A project aimed at simplifying the digital life of elderly people and individuals with motor disabilities, through an easy-to-use interface.
bigDescription: Vel.IO focuses on accessibility and simplicity: large controls, clear contrast and straightforward flows to help elderly and motor-impaired users achieve daily tasks online. I worked on UI improvements and accessibility fixes.
